_comment: PUBLIC CREDITS for support.html. Rendered by sync_site.py into the <!--CONTRIBUTORS--> slot.  ⚠⚠ CONSENT IS THE WHOLE RULE OF THIS FILE. Nobody goes in it until they have said yes, in writing, in the bot. This product's standing privacy rule is that one person never learns another's identity from it, and a public credits list is the one deliberate exception — so it has to be opt-in, per person, every time.  ⚠ NEVER record an amount, a plan, or anything that implies one. 'Paid for a month of the server' is as specific as money gets. A list that ranks contributors by rupees turns a thank-you into a leaderboard.  ⚠ NEVER copy a name out of the users table. The name Telegram gives is not permission to publish it.  ⚠ 'for' is free text and is shown as-is, so keep it short and factual: what they did, not praise.  Empty list is FINE and renders an honest empty state.
